earnings.title: Extra Space Storage Inc.
highlights: Achieved net income attributable to common stockholders of $1.17 per diluted share, representing a 50.0% increase compared to the same period in the prior year, which included a loss from real estate assets sold in 2025.
Same-store revenue increased by 2.7% and same-store expense decreased by 1.8%, resulting in a same-store net operating income (“NOI”) increase of 4.6% compared to the same period in the prior year.

Achieved net income attributable to common stockholders of $3.56 per diluted share, representing a 10.2% increase compared to the same period in the prior year, which included a loss from real estate assets sold in 2025.
Reported ending same-store occupancy of 94.0% as of September 30, 2026, compared to 93.7% as of September 30, 2025.
Repurchased 2,390,497 shares of common stock for $327.1 million at an average price of $136.85 per share using its stock repurchase program.

quotes.text: Our platform, portfolio and people continue to outperform, with Core FFO per share growth of 4.3% and accelerating same-store performance. We remain focused on disciplined capital allocation and compounding long-term value per share, including through the opportunistic repurchase of our shares this quarter.
